issues.title: Truncated Error Catalog and missing sections
issues.why: The spec file 07-error-catalog.md is truncated mid-sentence at the end of the provided context, leaving the 'Push' table incomplete and missing subsequent files (08, 09, 17, 18).
issues.fix: Provide the complete text for files 07 through 18 to ensure the AI has the full mapping of CI provider bindings and classification logic.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'interleaved' capture implementation
issues.why: Section 04 specifies capturing stdout/stderr 'interleaved with timestamps', but doesn't define if this requires a pseudo-terminal (PTY) or simple pipe merging, which affects line ordering.
issues.fix: Explicitly state that runners must be invoked via a PTY to preserve real-time interleaving or accept standard pipe merging.

issues.title: Undefined 'GitProfile' in doctor check
issues.why: GLCI-DOCTOR-PROFILE-NOT-FOUND refers to a 'GitProfile' in the admin UI, but the CLI's role in identifying this profile (beyond RepoUrl) is not pinned.
issues.fix: Clarify that the server maps RepoUrl to a GitProfile and the CLI merely reports the resulting 404.
